info.title: API-DocTest-Create Telecom Sim Replacement-v3-spec
info.description: The Telecom SIM Replacement API facilitates the process of initiating a replacement for telecom SIM cards. Designed for customer service representatives or automated systems, this API allows users to request replacements for damaged, lost, or stolen SIMs efficiently. It supports the handling of customer data and service requests in a streamlined manner. Typical use cases include customer support interactions and self-service applications for end users requiring immediate assistance with their telecom services.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to initiate the process of replacing a SIM card. Users can submit a request to replace their existing SIM due to loss, damage, or other reasons.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit a new SIM replacement operation. It contains details regarding the replacement process, such as the SIM card information and the customer details. Ensure that all required fields are accurately filled to facilitate the process.

200.description: The request was successfully processed, and the replacement details are returned.
